name: Silent Exception Swallowing
diff:
diff --git a/app/billing.py b/app/billing.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/app/billing.py
+++ b/app/billing.py
@@ -1,4 +1,7 @@
 def charge_customer(customer_id, amount):
     try:
         gateway.charge(customer_id, amount)
+    except Exception:
+        # Silently discarding payment processing failure
+        pass
explanation: except Exception: pass swallows errors silently without logging or alerting.
